text:
Eli: Quick PSA: found a majestic blue pen taped under the conference table with a tiny note: "Do not let it leave the room." :pen:
Nora: The Blue Pen of Duarte? This is an escalation. Is this the legendary one that never runs out? :eyes:
Sam: Legend says it writes in midnight ink and refuses to be borrowed by interns. Highly selective. :mage:
Priya: We should form a council immediately. Rules proposal: 1) It stays in meeting rooms, 2) only used for signing ceremonials (pizza orders, kudos), 3) ritual rubbing of cap once per sprint. Agree? React with :thumbsup: if yes.
Eli: Also can we get a name? I was thinking "The Pen of Perpetual Promise" or "Blue of Binding". Too dramatic? :laughing:
Nora: Vote: "Perpetual Promise" or "Blue of Binding". React :one: for Perpetual, :two: for Binding.
Sam: OpsBot, set a recurring reminder: "Blue Pen check" every Friday 4pm. Ping #random.
OpsBot: Scheduled: "Blue Pen check"  Fridays 16:00  Reminder set to channel #random. See /reminders for details.
Priya: If we name it, can we make a tiny plaque? I have a laminator. Also propose we attach a sign: "If you borrow, leave a cookie." Mandatory pastry clause.
Eli: Found the original note. It said: "For urgent signatures & strong opinions. Return promptly." Who leaves notes like that? Heroic mystery person.
Nora: Council duties: keeper (ensures it's in the room), scribe (records usage in a one-line log), and pastry warden (accepts cookie tributes). Volunteers?
Sam: I'll be scribe. I already log whiteboard jokes, this seems natural.
Priya: I'll be pastry warden in exchange for creative control of cookie variety. No raisins without consent. :cookie:
Eli: Poll results: Perpetual Promise (3), Blue of Binding (2). Winner: Perpetual Promise. New plaque text draft: "The Pen of Perpetual Promise — Signed with intention since time immemorial."
Nora: Also tiny ritual on first use: everyone says one word about their day and tap the cap. Short, low-commitment. :sparkles:
Sam: Added a one-line ledger entry today: "2141000000 - Eli - signed meeting notes - 1 cookie offered". This will go in the shared doc.
Priya: Reminder: if you take it out for an offsite, please leave a photo of the pen in situ. It's a tradition now. We need proof-of-return.
Eli: Also, pro tip: don't leave it next to the fountain pens. They are dramatic and will whisper about it.
Nora: Closing: long live the Pen of Perpetual Promise. If anyone knows the mystery donor, claim your glory or remain forever anonymous.
Eli: Official first action: use it at the sprint retro to sign the Tiny Trophy. Ceremony at 4:45pm tomorrow. Bring cookies.
OpsBot: Reminder: "Sprint Retro Signing - Pen of Perpetual Promise" tomorrow 16:45 in #random.
Priya: I will bake oat-chocolate cookies. No raisins. Promise.
